title: OpenAI Models Optimize Production Jalapeño Silicon, AMD Flagship GPU RTL, and RISC-V Cores
shortTitle: OpenAI Silicon & AMD RTL Chip Design
aiSystem: OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra / GPT-o3 mini + Synopsys EDA
whyItMatters: OpenAI frontier models rewrote production SystemVerilog RTL to cut silicon-proven Jalapeño area by 10–13% and deliver up to 14% PPA gains on AMD flagship GPU IP sent for manufacturing.
summary: On November 18, 2026, OpenAI reported expert-level hardware microarchitecture and SystemVerilog RTL optimizations verified with Synopsys EDA tools across production silicon and open-source processors. On OpenAI’s first custom inference chip, Jalapeño, model-proposed redesigns across floating-point adders, multipliers (including one cutting cell area ~15% while halving latency from two cycles to one), dot-product logic, and pipeline stages reduced standard-cell area by roughly 13% in the vector unit and 10% in the matrix unit—gains confirmed during physical silicon bring-up. In a collaboration with AMD, OpenAI’s model rewrote production SystemVerilog RTL verified in Synopsys to achieve up to 14% power-performance-area (PPA) improvements over heavily optimized baselines on AMD’s flagship GPU IP (roughly a year of microarchitectural progress in under five months, already taped into manufacturing designs), plus single-digit PPA gains on next-generation flagship CPU blocks. Across 9,881 scored evaluation runs on open-source 32-bit RISC-V cores (PicoRV32 and OpenTitan Ibex), GPT-6.2 Astra achieved the highest throughput both when optimizing existing RTL and when designing cores directly from written specifications.
technicalHighlights: Silicon-proven ~13% vector-unit and ~10% matrix-unit standard-cell area reductions on OpenAI’s Jalapeño inference chip, including a 15% smaller multiplier halving latency from 2 cycles to 1.

Delivered up to 14% PPA improvement over heavily optimized baselines on AMD flagship GPU IP in under 5 months—with changes integrated into manufacturing tapeouts—plus verified gains on next-gen AMD CPU blocks.
Across 9,881 Yosys/simulation-verified runs on PicoRV32 and Ibex RISC-V cores, GPT-6.2 Astra topped all models in both RTL optimization and from-specification processor design.
caveats: Reported via company technical publication rather than peer-reviewed hardware conference proceedings; RISC-V from-specification evaluations omit certain production features and physical place-and-route timing signoff.

scoreRationale.foundational: Demonstrates frontier reasoning models performing expert-level SystemVerilog microarchitecture redesign grounded in formal EDA equivalence and synthesis checks.
scoreRationale.ripple: Directly accelerates the recursive hardware loop powering future AI compute across custom inference accelerators, flagship GPUs, and CPUs.
scoreRationale.verification: Jalapeño optimizations are silicon-proven at bring-up and AMD GPU RTL rewrites passed Synopsys formal equivalence and entered manufacturing tapeouts.
scoreRationale.velocity: Compressed roughly a year of elite GPU microarchitecture PPA progress into under five months.
